newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chase Manhattan raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chase Manhattan raised.

text.p: -- Gerard Klauer Mattison said it upgraded Chase Manhattan Corp to buy from hold.
-- raised earnings estimates to $7.35 per share from $7.30 for 1996, and to $8.75 from $8.50 for 1997.
-- said credit card loan quality is "better than we believed." Card loan outstandings have grown more slowly, and company has better risk profile.
-- merger between Chemical Banking and Chase "is ahead of schedule and has been non-problematic."
-- set 12-month price target of $95. Shares rose two to 78-3/8.
